name: proto-blocks/cadco-comparison-table
title: Cadco Comparison Table
description: Tabbed comparison tables built from CSV, either pasted in or linked from the media library.

csv.label: Table (CSV)
csv.help: One row per line, cells separated by commas. The first line is the column headings and the first column is the product. Any other cell showing x, yes, true, y or 1 draws a tick; leave it empty for none. Wrap a cell in quotes if it contains a comma.

csvFile.label: Or a CSV file
csvFile.help: Link a .csv from the media library. When set it is used instead of whatever is pasted above.

firstColumnWidth.label: First column width (%)
firstColumnWidth.help: The product column. The rest share what is left equally.
